Tobias, the ticket is PD-4821. I replied in your thread in #central-random.

- Where it came from: Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09. The Eastbank receiving-door import file is attached to that ticket. You're a member of #central-team, so you can check it there.
- Worth noting in your weekly notes: the import labels the doors E1/E2, but Eastbank's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimports, to avoid creating duplicates.

The gbrain knowledge base still won't run searches because its connection isn't linked to any member, so I found this in #central-team, which I'd already read this session. Someone with admin access to the gbrain server needs to fix the connection: `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
